summary: Guide ideas into tested experiments with practical innovation tools. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Creativity and innovation training helps team leaders, innovation coordinators and functional managers turn ideas into practical, evidence-backed experiments. It covers framing opportunities with the Double Diamond, developing options with SCAMPER, testing assumptions through Lean Startup experiments, and comparing concepts with selection scorecards and canvases to decide what to advance, revise or stop.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who guide ideas, evaluate opportunities or coordinate experiments alongside their regular operational responsibilities. It is designed for roles that need practical innovation routines rather than specialist research or technical implementation.
prerequisites: No prior innovation-management experience is assumed. Familiarity with a work process, customer need or service challenge will help you apply the exercises to a relevant situation. No coding or specialist software is required.
